restore.title: Mediation, compression and reconstructability
restore.diagnostic: Is an accurate derivative representation being promoted from orientation to understanding or adjudication, and can its losses still be reconstructed?
restore.constructive_move: Type the representation's epistemic role, lower allowed compression as claim burden rises, and preserve a traceback from synthesis through claims and evidence to source context.
restore.self_risk: Treating formal reconstructability as sufficient understanding, or turning every useful summary into a suspect substitute.
restore.positive_model: Role-Bounded Compression with explicit loss, alternative unitizations and reversible source routes.
